description: Tune your guitar with real pitch detection — the mic listens, autocorrelation finds your note, and the needle shows how many cents sharp or flat you are.

faqs.a: Yes — it uses autocorrelation on the microphone signal, a genuine pitch-detection algorithm.
Standard tuning E2–A2–D3–G3–B3–E4. Click a string button, then play that string.
A needle gauge shows cents sharp/flat (±50¢) plus the detected frequency in Hz.
faqs.q: How do I know when I'm in tune?

faqs.a: Your browser will ask for microphone permission. If denied, the tool explains how to re-enable it.
faqs.q: Why does it need the microphone?

howto: Select a string (or let it auto-detect).
Play the string — watch the needle and cents readout.
Tune until the needle centers and turns green.
title: Online Guitar Tuner
